events.name: Greener Energy
events.description:
As technology progressed, many fields of science quickly solved global issues such as illness and water scarcity, but it quickly became clear that the worsening climate of the planet would become the next major obstacle to surpass. Scientists all over the globe scrambled for ideas to produce cost-effective clean energy that could become a worldwide standard.

Dr. Justina Borda was one of the first to tackle this issue. A phycologist specialized in genetics, who sought to improve energy equity in her home of Colombia. Borda developed a strain of algae capable of thriving in low oxygen waters and photosynthesizing at disproportionate speeds. And after many attempts, she was able to get the energy produced by the algae to work alongside a Goldilocks Generator, taking the excess of electricity from the algae and essentially transforming any body of water into a solar panel.

Borda's invention spread across the world rapidly, as rural communities quickly standardized its use, to the point that even the most remote corners of the world have bodies of water where their creation managed to propagate. As her invention became the norm, the public moved away from fossil fuels for their daily energy consumption.

Borda kickstarted a green energy revolution, and as superstorms became all the more common, the wind energy industry followed, which ultimately led to a decrease in carbon emissions of more than 20 percent during this period, giving humanity hope for a better tomorrow.

Cláudio Martins was a wealthy Portuguese entrepreneur, married to a Venezuelan ecological activist, Hector Martins. The pair were known for their inventions, and together they used their resources to propose to the Portuguese Government to begin the construction of a giant sea wall.

The Wall was to be made out of Durovidro, a synthetic material Cláudio himself had invented years earlier. Not only was it nearly as tough as a diamond, but it also had the unique quality of neutralizing acidity, which made it perfect for both solving the rising tides eroding the coast, and preserving the ecosystems around the area. But by far their biggest accomplishment would come with the invention of solar threading, a unique way of harvesting condensed solar energy into beams of light. According to the academy's teachings, centuries ago, a wise family had dedicated themselves to the understanding and application of the traditional Wuxing philosophy, and the study of the building blocks of the world. With the years of accumulated knowledge, they founded what later became the University, where traditional wisdom was to pioneer new science, for students to have all the knowledge of the past available to guide their future.

The University, true to its name, splits its fields of study into five categories, relating to the phases of the Wuxing teachings.
The Fire College, for the study of martial arts and defensive strategies.
The Metal College, for robotics and technological engineering.
The Water College, for traditional medicine and applications into new medical advancements.
The Earth College, for agricultural and sustainability studies.
And Wood College, for civil and environmental engineering.

Each of these faculties played major roles in China's major advancements during the following decades, quickly increasing the College's prestige across the world.

Omnica Corporation started from humble beginnings and quickly rose up as a multinational entity, with an annual budget larger than some nations. Omnics were highly advanced Ais that came in many forms, though largely humanoid, and with enough capability for learning and adapting to many different situations, making them have mass appeal as domestic caretakers, companions and substitutes for all kinds of hard labor. Omnics started to appear everywhere, going from more crude, voiceless models first only affordable by the upper class, to fully personable voiced iterations, mass produced for people all over the world.

events.name: Nourishing the World
events.description:
Climate change heavily affected the agricultural industry, as many crops will stop being viable, leading to farmlands across the world becoming deserted. As humanity risked famine across the board, GMOs seemed like the obvious solution, especially after the success of Borda's Algae and Taupega's Supercoral, which heavily reshaped public opinion on artificially enhanced life.

As the first set of genetically modified crops began to solve the farming problem, it was precisely their mass appeal that caused harsher regulations on their use, for both safety and privatization reasons. Mega-corporations leading this push for artificial crops kept a tight leash on their licensing, leading to multiple lawsuits and price fixing, as farmers couldn't compete with the improved crops, and yet also couldn't afford the seeds themselves.
This whole ordeal came to a stop in court, when Matthew Frank, a Manhattan lawyer, convinced the Supreme Court that bio-engineered seeds couldn't be held under a patent or copyright, because they were transformative works of an indigenous species. It also helped to his case that, during the pandemics and outbreaks of the previous decades, the rush to get vaccines ready lead to a lot of patents getting dismissed for the sake of saving lives.

Thanks to this historic legal victory, the GMO crops became effectively open sourced, and with it, effectively solving world hunger. The rise of these highly effective crops led to corporate farmers, who would partner with Omnica Corporation to use a robotic workforce, leading to more efficient, but larger megafarms that quickly encompassed most of the world's arable lands. It was business ventures like this that led to Omnica's advertising motto: "Putting power in your hands".
headlines: GMO crops become open sourced after historical legal win in New York

events.name: Hardlight for the World
events.description:
Dr. Vishwakarma Bhatt had worked for a long time on an ambitious project in Bengaluru, trying to find a method to essentially solidify light. The project had taken years and many of those in his discipline moved on, but Bhatt persisted until he finally got a working prototype. His Photon Projectors were capable of altering photon reactivity, coaxing them into binding, creating crystalline structures, capable of bonding with carbon, forming a durable physical object made out of carbon fibers. This would be known to the world as Hardlight.

The project was slow but promising, and thanks to the United Nations Global Recovery Program, he would get the grants needed to kickstar Vishkar, and lead his team in researching ways to use this technology in infrastructure. Bhatt envisioned a future where Hardlight would solve housing shortages, transportation issues and material inequity. He always wished for this technology to remain accessible to the public, as a gift to the world.

Unfortunately, a tragic car accident would end his life, and the company would move on without him, away from his altruistic philosophy. Exactly one year after Bhatt's death, Vishkar made its first public offerings.

events.name: Automation
events.description:
With the introduction of God Programs the world had essentially been set to automatic. On a smaller scale, less complex AIs were able to control local traffic, stocking stores, and manage public work projects, among other things, while on a global level, the God Programs handled these resources and many more with an international perspective in mind, ensuring equity, efficiency and progress. 

While their power allowed humanity to take a back seat as the world moved forward, many skeptics worried that these God Programs were given too much power, and had too much leeway to make decisions, and to calm these fears. Each God Ai was under a constant feedback loop by a dedicated team of programmers that provided its maintenance and supervision, allowing humanity to catch any possible mistakes or concerning choices before it was too late.

It was not just God AIs making life easier, as by this point Omnics were common household items. They impacted everyday life across the vast majority of nations, becoming the main workforce in multiple manual labor fields, which resulted in the loss of many jobs at first, but with God Programs allowing for global scale choreographing of resources, they were able to identify the areas of need and ensure equity and new opportunities around the globe. As robotics took over most forms of labor, Germany wanted to prevent unemployment, so they began developing a sector yet touched by AI. One of these areas was marine exploration, as the government began backing the development of exoskeletal diving suits developed by Leon Honisch, an oceanologist who was dedicated to exploring the North Sea. Major Greta Klein approached Honish with an initiative, to modify his Robo-Tauchanzug design into equipment for their soldiers, as the suits were designed to withstand heavy pressures and damage. Alongside them, Emillia Fischer was called to improve the design for combat use. Fischer was one of the early hard-light architects, one of many that took Vishkar's technology into new boundaries. Fischer had used it before to enhance the shielding of fusion reactors, and when called into the initiative, she adapted this technology into hardlight barriers, capable of taking consistent damage, and regenerating after breaking, with the pair on board, the Crusader armors were born.

While he had been lured into the project, Honisch argued that the move might not be taken kindly abroad, given the country's military history, although Fischer argued that in spite of the controversy that re militarization could cause, Germany needed a means to defend itself if it came to it. During development, the pair found a compromise, and with it the Crusaders were reframed as defenders of the country, rather than a weapon of war. They redesigned their armor to resemble that of fabled knights, and with the help of local artisans, heavily decorated them to be used in parades and boost support among the public. events.name: The Lagos Attack
events.description:
Before the full on war began, Anubis first tested his plan on a smaller scale. On the first day of the crisis, Anubis launched a coordinated attack on Lagos, coming from the Nigerian Omnium. As the attack pushed further in, domestic Omnic units began to attack civilians, and since most of the services and communications were handled by machines, the flow of information to the outside world was nearly non-existent.

The international community turned its eyes on Nigeria with fear and confusion, only to be caught by surprise the same way soon after. Many believed this to be an isolated attack and thus humanity was completely unprepared for what came next. Within eighteen hours of the initial attack, Anubis began to seize control of domestic robots across the planet, and deployed massive waves of warbots towards major population centers. Chaos reigned everywhere, and many nations began pointing fingers at each other, with at least five confirmed nuclear powers preparing counterattacks, the world was minutes away from nuclear obliteration before intelligence operatives realized the attacks were happening globally and not orchestrated by a single nation.

As the Omnics gained ground across rural and suburban areas, many of the world's wealthiest elites began to retreat into prebuilt doomsday bunkers, which feed conspiracy theorists and distrust among the people. The bunkers themselves were largely ineffective. However, as a majority of them would sooner or later be destroyed by Anubis' forces, few of these structures remained strong by the end of the Crisis.

events.name: The Caribbean Coalition
events.description:
As the warbots caused chaos and bloodshed across the world, nature had its way to show cruel mercy to the Caribbean. The region has been consistently slammed with Super Storms due to a changing climate. Anubis had prepared to attack people from all regions and environments, with the islands of the Atlantic being hit by waves of subaquatic units deployed via drop pods from motherships. While effective, not even Anubis could have foreseen the raw power of Hurricane Crystal, a massive Super Storm that made landfall in Havana shortly after the global attacks began.

The destruction of the storm caused just as much tragedy and loss as the Omnics, but it also disrupted the incoming Anubis forces during these initial assaults. This brief stalemate allowed military groups across the region to organize a defensive alliance, with skilled soldiers and marksmen hopping from one island to another to stop the incoming attacks together. This alliance would be known as the Caribbean Coalition, and by the time the storm had passed, they had gathered enough support and manpower to go toe to toe against the incoming waves of warbots. 

From beginning to end, the Coalition would stay locked in a brutal fight against Anubis, as people from Belice to Guyana, and all the Antilles came together to help each other in their time of need. If all the mighty storms that nature threw at them seasonally were not enough to blow their will away, then they would never yield to Anubis either.

events.name: Early Victories
events.description:
While the whole world got attacked at once, generally major population centers and cities close to Omniums got the short end of the stick. However, to this day, historians are stunned by the seeming pettiness Anubis felt towards Russia. Not just cities, but small towns and villages, no matter how remote, were ravished by the attacks at disproportionate rates to the rest of the planet, and to make it worse in the chaos of the early attacks, Russia lost outside communication entirely. Nine days had passed, and at last, when the channels got reopened, the world waited in fear of the worst, and was met with a short audio response that shook the entire globe, "Hello, we won!"

How did it happen? Multiple factors allowed for Russia's early victories against the army of warbots. For once, the size of the country and the often isolated nature of many communities meant that domestic Omnics were all the more popular than in most of the world, which, tragically, would result in a lot more violence when they got taken over. Anubis had decided upon a very specific strategy for its initial attack. Its simulations suggested that going first after individuals between their teens and their forties would lead to the eventual collapse of the nation. Going after the strongest, army-ready individuals first, to leave the young and the elderly defenseless seems like a sound plan for the God program, so the first battalions were directed to ignore humans outside its target range.

When the attacks started, however, people of all ages fought back. Young and old rebelled alongside more able fighters, brandishing makeshift weapons like crowbars and steel bats to defend themselves. Millions died within the first day of the Crisis, and globally the situation seemed hopeless. But the brave spirit of these Russian fighters gave people a chance to keep going.

events.name: Swedish Engineering
events.description:
In the years leading up to the Crisis, Torbjörn Lindholm had destroyed much of his reputation due to his vocal criticism of the expanding presence of advanced robots in society, and as legislation against AI seemed to consistently fail, he retreated back to his home in Gothenburg. Less than a week had passed from his return when the Crisis started. Lindholm's household was completely unaffected by the initial strike, as his family never allowed domestic units at home, and the hidden turret-powered security systems of the Ironclad Workshop turned Lindholm's home into the safest place in the entire city during these early attacks. 

As the Omnic Troops marched across Europe, killing people in the thousands per day, Torbjörn would be almost immediately drafted into helping the government find a solution. Lindholm was a major player in fighting back most of Anubis' army, as he realized quickly most warbot units were modified versions of his own designs, like the Bastions and Titans. Feeling responsible for the massacre these machines caused, he did not resist to the draft, and quickly began expanding the defense systems he designed in Gothenburg to be used across the country. Within days, turrets were installed on streets and buildings all across Sweden, keeping citizens safe and changing their public image, as news made the rounds across Europe of the Man who would save Sweden, with Ironclad tools in hand, and brain in gear. While he objected to that title, choosing to credit those helping out on the installation, he was willing to do anything it took to protect people from the Omnic menace.

events.name: Expanding the Wall
events.description:
Portugal did not have any Omniums built in the country, and it lacked a substantial population of domestic robots. What was once seen as a weakness for the nation, turned out to be of great benefit when the Crisis began, as it meant that the country was granted several days to prepare as the warbots made their way from the outside. The Omnic troops approached Portugal, both between the land and the sea, surrounding the country, yet when the Omnics got close to the coast, they came to a halt by the sea wall. The Durovidro Wall was durable enough to stop the incoming army, and as they focused all their firepower into destroying it, it bought the military enough time to retaliate. The Martins came back at the government's petition, seeking to find a way to prepare for the next wave, and as the pair studied the battlefield, they realized that while the wall showed cracks from bullets and explosives, it absorbed energy blasts and beams, merely discoloring the glass without leaving a scratch. 

A deal was made to expand the wall further across the Iberian Peninsula, as the Spanish government agreed to join forces with Portugal in a defensive alliance against Omnics. Over the course of the crisis, the wall would be expanded to reach the Strait of Gibraltar, successfully stopping the robot armies from breaching by sea. As thanks for their efforts and the incredible feat of engineering, Spain gifted the Martins with a small research center at the coast of Gibraltar, which they could use as they pleased.

events.name: To Hell With Them
events.description:
Anubis primarily targeted a curated list of major population centers that it had decided leading up to the crisis, as they were the greatest source of pollutants and the ones that required the most resources. As a result, large cities such as New York were hit the hardest across the globe. Anubis had targeted communication hubs, essentially making Manhattan disappear from any radar for several hours, as the bloodshed continued without outside help to come. The state governor was contacted at last during a short respite, but instead of getting the back up they desperately needed, they were left to die.

The military had been stretched tin from the waves of warbots coming from all sides, so the governor did the unthinkable and decided to declare New York City a lost cause, issuing an evacuation order and hoping that as people escaped the metropolitan area, it would ease pressure on the military. In spite of his advice, the people of NYC were not going to listen. City Major Michelle Aguirre, a former army engineer, was insulted by the decision and publicly disregarded the evacuation order, knowing only the rich would afford to escape, leaving common folk to die. Aguirre would come forth with the now informally known "To hell with them" address, where she urged New Yorkers to rally together, because if the state, and the country at large was willing to write them off, they would not do the same for each other. 

Alongside the commonfolk, a group of military forces was left behind to aid the evacuation, led by Colonel Liliana Fox. Fox was a Manhattan native and close to the mayor, so as the city chose to fight, she took their side and aided the effort. Working together, they outlined the New York City Defense Act, calling for veterans and citizens of fighting age to assemble for training. Here is where Anubis' endless intelligence showed flaws to predict human ingenuity and determination, as in focusing so much of its resources into such a defensible, fortified area as Manhattan, it set itself up to defeat. The New Yorkers stood together to defend the city they loved, or die trying.

events.name: Launching Into the Skies
events.description:
The Crisis was not just fought on land and water, as Anubis took its efforts into the skies. In the years prior to the Crisis, the Indian Space Research Organization had adapted the Mag-Lev technology pioneered by Dr. De Kuiper, and installed a  massive launch track of levitating magnetic accelerator launchers across India. This track allowed cargo to reach orbital velocity consistently and quickly, reducing the cost for low orbit launches across the world.

Anubis, naturally, predicted that in order to prevent efficient human communication, taking down and seizing most satellites orbiting the planet was going to be a main priority early on. ISRO's launchers thus became a key player in the Indian side of the war, as they were responsible for consistently launching new satellites equipped with antimissile technology to quickly counteract Anubis' efforts to shut down the human network. As India kept production steady, Anubis troops would shift focus to destroying the Orbital Launchers themselves, until only one remained standing, next to the Roshani river. The military focused entirely on protecting the last remaining launcher as engineers kept the pipeline flowing through the rest of the crisis, until the last launcher finally fell. 

The launch tracks were never rebuilt, as technology advanced and allowed for a new generation of launchers. Massive, trackless levitating rings spread across India nowadays, including one looming over Roshani, where the last of the original launchers had once been.

events.name: Fiery Pride
events.description:
As the Crisis went on, innovation became vital. All across the world it seemed  that warbots were actively learning from every encounter, and you could never defeat them the same way twice. It is no surprise, then, that some of the most vital discoveries came from university students and teachers.

Wuxing University was already a prestigious college known for taking knowledge of old things and applying it to new technology, and when the Crisis came, its students were well-prepared. The Metal College students and faculty were already working to develop some of the most cutting-edge weaponry available for China, with multiple Mech designs capable of fighting with the larger Omnic Units. But one of the calls to fame of the school was when a task force of Fire College Alumni were able to defeat an incoming fleet of warbots by themselves. This side of the school focused on martial arts and defensive strategy, making them particularly adept warriors that, on top of their own studies and discipline, wielded weapons unlike anything else Anubis had accounted for. Fiery gear, capable of bending and floating in the air, guided by the users, which combined well with their close combat.

This success during the Crisis boosted the school's reputation and prestige, particularly for the Metal and especially Fire Colleges, where, between their popularity, the desire people had to defend their homes, and the sense of honor and pedigree that came from Wuxing's standard, made both of these the top hardest college to be admitted into, til this day. The other colleges, of course, were just as vital, with Water students providing medical aid to civilians, while Wood and Earth Colleges managed the analytics and optics of the impact the war would leave on the world. But in the eyes of the world, the mechs and the fire-wielding fighters were the ones everyone admired, and the true source of pride for the school.

events.name: Children of the Sun
events.description:
Solar energy has forever changed the people of Peru, both in the way it defined their way of life for communities across the mountains, but also for the selected few that had been chosen to wield the sun itself in their body. The Paqarina research group had experimented with cybernetic applications to the Solar threading techniques, imbuing several of their community's strongest and most determined fighters with augments capable of harnessing the Sun's power through their cybernetics. These chosen few were known as the Children of the Sun, and with their augments they were able to gift the Sun directly to their people, as providers of energy and warm, miraculous healers, and when the time came, as protectors.

The Inti Warriors, as they were known by many on the outside, were able to fight off Anubis' forces, thanks to the versatility of their technology and the raw power harnessed directly from the sun, that flowed through their bodies. The augments not only powered their weaponry, they also allowed them to regulate the surrounding temperature, using the convection currents created by their thermodynamics to lift off into the sky.

These children of the Sun served their roles as guardians of Runasapi and the Andean mountains, and became a source of pride for their people, to the point that even years after the crisis, the Paqarina research group kept the program active, training aspiring warriors since young, preparing them for the day of their augmentation ceremony, so that they too can use the gifts the Sun gives them to help their people, and if the time ever came again, protect them once more.

events.name: Force the Sun to Set
events.description:
All over the world, heroic figures started to appear throughout the entire Crisis, remarkable individuals that stood out amongst the crowd for their bravery, ingenuity and perhaps most notoriously, superhuman abilities. From genetically enhanced soldiers, to cybernetic warriors, to mech pilots and rocket-powered knights, it appears that all over the planet, individuals branding the latest weapons and technology available to them are making actual progress at repelling warbot attacks. But there was perhaps no figure more notorious and heavily debated, than the mysterious Savior of Nigeria, the Doomfist.

Nigeria had endured constant war since the beginning of the crisis, as the high population numbers of Lagos and proximity to an Omnium made it the clearest target for Anubis to go after. When the attacks became global, neighboring countries increased their efforts to block their borders with Nigeria, offering little help and hoping to keep the invasion within the country. All seemed lost, until one night, in the city of Ibadan, he appeared. A single man, carrying no guns, just a metallic gauntlet in his right hand. According to witnesses, the man would leap into the air and piledrive into the machines with impossible force, wrecking the warbots and brawling entire waves of them for hours until sunrise. 

A young eyewitness approached the man, scared. The kid asked the hero if the war was over, to which his response was, "No, but there is strength in struggle. With each fight for our home, I grow stronger, and I will keep our people safe". The man disappeared as authorities arrived to provide aid. But he would show up every night to repel the Omnic forces once more. Witnesses describe his battles as both brutal and beautiful, like an artist at work. His presence spelled the doom of those who crossed his gauntlet, and thus the first mighty Doomfist was born.

events.description:
I need for better defenses to battle Anubis, the RDF pumped all the money and resources they could into Volskaya Industries, allowing the company to finish the development of their Svyatogor unit. Gigantic mechs that were deployed across Russia Midway through the Crisis. These defensive units were equipped with arm-mounted canons that decimated warbot waves, but they also retained mechanical hands, which proved useful for evacuating civilians and creating barricades. Their size also meant they could go one to one against one of the biggest threads in the conflict, the Titan units. These giants were mostly unstoppable, but their construction did not account for close combat with units around the same size. So if both a Titan and Svyatogor fell, only one of them would get back up. The Svyatogor was also designed to endure the Russian winters, and resistant to most kinds of attacks.

Thanks to the Volskaya mechs, Russia was able to fight the crisis alone all the way through, without the need of external help, a feat of which they are proud even today. The mechs were not only effective at protecting small, isolated towns, they were also capable of holding the line in Moscow, in spite of the brutal number of warbots that Anubis sent their way. The God program was unable to keep up with the efficiency and scale of the Svyagotor units, forcing it to redirect most of its resources towards Russia, which left Scandinavia largely spared from the massacre. Sadly both Alisa and her son Mikhail would not survive the crisis, leaving Katherina Voslkaya, Alisa's daughter to inherit the company.

events.name: The Proposal
events.description:
The crisis had dragged on for months, and no progress had been made on ending it. Anubis learned from every battle, you could never beat troops down the same way. The United Nations did what they could to find a unified solution, but by the second month of the crisis, each country was reluctant to share information, fearing that sharing their success would render it useless as Anubis learned how to counter it. Here is where Dr. Gabrielle Adawe stepped forward with an audacious proposal. The Nigerian diplomat was the third-highest post in the UN and seeing the success of outstanding individuals like the Doomfist in her homeland gave her an idea. To form a team of gifted individuals, backed up by the international guide and authority of the United Nations. The team would travel around the world and respond to calls for help, in a faster, more flexible way than any other group could. 

The proposal outlined a surgical strike team, operating based on the situation rather than national interests or orders. Acting in the moment, and combining their unique skill sets from across the globe would render them unpredictable by Anubis, ensuring no two fights against them were ever the same. In addition to this strike team, a selection of the greatest minds the world had to offer would operate in the background. Scientists, engineers, tacticians, medics, working together to organize the team's movements and ensure out-of-the-box thinking. In spite of resistance and criticism, after many special sessions, the code name Overwatch program was approved, and the process of selecting the team began.

events.name: The Heroic Five
events.description:
Gothenburg was able to avoid major damage, with Anubis focusing on Russia and the Ironclad defense systems. The city spent several months without major attacks. This calmed down most people in the city, and an influx of refugees came rushing in, but the brightest minds were already worrying about what could come next.

In an effort to plan ahead, the Hjältefemman came together. Five inventors from different fields, computer analysts, agricultural engineers, material engineers and business managers, who bent their intellects towards a single question: how to save nearly four million people from a surprise attack by Anubis. The Heroic Five collaborated using resources from each other to develop new technology, collaborating with local hardware companies to improve the designs using shielding technology and new materials created by the group. The result was the Portable Steel Blanket, an extremely durable bunked made to withstand concussive blasts, extreme heat and designed for quick deployment, easy to repair and capable of housing up to eight people inside of it. The group called for help by the government to manufacture these steel blankets in large numbers. For a long period in the Crisis, humanity did not know what was causing all the chaos. Anubis had targeted so many cities at once everyone was too busy to truly find the root of the Crisis, and what's more, the God program amassed a giant army in Cairo. Widely regarded as the best sniper in the world, in great part due to her cybernetic eye, Amari had become an invaluable asset for the Egyptian military, supporting troops from afar, with impeccable aim and efficiency, confusing many of the warbot troops and drawing their attention away from civilians. While everywhere around the world news were appearing of inhuman soldiers and giant machines, Ana was a regular person with no major augmentation beyond what was accessible to the public. The war had split Amari's family off. events.name: Defense Network
events.description:
A few weeks into the Crisis, Lindholm would be called by the Swedish government, asking him to complete a design for a countrywide Defense Network. After the success of his workshop's defenses in Gothenburg, he had gained quite the reputation, and if there was anyone capable of pulling this off, Sweden believed it was him.  The proposal was drawn by bureaucrats who didn't understand the scope of what they asked, wanting a miracle on a shoestring budget. An anti-aircraft weapons system that mimicked the functions of Finland's security God AI Chernobog, capable of warning citizens about air strikes nationwide and with mass-produced turret systems across population centers in Sweden.

What would have been an impossible task for anyone else, was exactly the challenge that Torbjörn had been waiting for his whole life. While working alongside a team of the greatest minds the nation could offer, they were able to roll out the systems at record time. His design for the Defense Network shared features that he would include to the sky cannons in New York, as well as the Siege systems he later deployed in Canada as part of Overwatch. While he was not formally invited into the strike team, he had heard of the program and believed he could be of use, having the reputation and expertise to back his claim up. Soon after visiting his family back home, he directed himself to the training facility and invited himself into the Overwatch Initiative.

events.name: The Skycannon
events.description:
The New Yorkers managed to endure the crisis on their own for months, coming up with one plan after another to use the city itself against Anubis. The wide cultural range and backgrounds of the many people involved allowed them to stay innovative and use the city's infrastructure to their advantage. Together they dug up and fortified shelters using parts from ships and skyscrapers, and organized to turn all green areas in the city, from rooftop gardens to Central Park, into communal farms that kept the population fed. At some point, Torbjörn Lindholm managed to find a way to contact the defenders from within the city and under his guidance they managed to work on defensive strategies. 

The citizens would mount battleship cannons onto Manhattan's skyscrapers and used to fire strategically at Null Sector Carriers to prevent them from reaching their deployment zones. Anubis would quickly take action and focus on bringing down these armored sky scrappers, but for a good while they bought the survivors enough time to plan ahead and fight on the ground. It was around this time that Anubis deployed the R-7000 Ravager units. Thanks to their high processing power, they were able to give orders independently of Anubis itself. With their arrival, it was clear that taking down Anubis wouldn't be enough to win the war.

events.description:
With the Crisis, the German Crusaders finally saw action, and proved to be quite effective defenders. Before the war, they were a niche group in the military with very few members, but once the Omnics attacked, they would become the center of Germany's military defense plans, as Honisch and Fischer worked on improving their capabilities, expanding their shield systems and equipping them with close-range weapons. Rocket Powered Axes and Hammers proved to be the most practical, and units were designed to charge into battle, ramming enemy waves at high speeds.

The appearance of a Crusader was enough to boost morale amongst the troops, in spite of the adversity and constant fire by Anubis. The initiative would see a surge in recruitments, as people from all walks of life, young and old, wished to defend their home, as a knight from tales of the old. The Crusader's power and cultural perspective lead to many of them fashioning themselves as chivalric heroes from fairy tales, acting by a strict code of conduct, based not on military orders, but rather on a mutual understanding, an unclaimed Oath that every Crusader was expected to follow, to live with honor, and die with glory.

events.name: Super Soldiers
events.description:
The Soldier Enhancement Program had been kept secret for a long time due to the many human rights violations going on with its research, and in spite of years of progress, Naughton lacked the ethical green light to move on to human subjects. That all changed when the Crisis started. The United States turned into multiple warzones overnight, and any measures they took to stop the bloodshed seemed only temporary. In desperation, the government decided to go public with the Soldier Enhancement Program. In spite of concerns, the program gathered plenty of public support due to the dire circumstances of the Crisis, and recruitment for human trials began, though at this time the concept was purely fictional. After the initial success with Soldier 00, Kendra Banks, the program moved forward on test trials with the rest of the volunteers.

At least two hundred military personnel volunteered for the SEP initially, but only a handful would survive the horrors that awaited them in Naughton's labs, about sixty percent of the subjects died throughout the program. Anubis was also keenly aware of the situation and targeted the labs on multiple occasions. The initial lab at Camp Hale was destroyed within weeks of the announcement, and the team had to hop from one facility to another. In the end, the successful soldiers would be deployed around the country and quickly turn the tides in many battles where they showed up.

The two most notorious successes of the program were Soldier 24: Gabriel Reyes, and Soldier 76: Jack Morrison. The reputation of these two men was legendary even before Overwatch, the golden-haired hero who appeared out of nowhere and saved the day. And although Reyes was quieter and usually took less flashy missions, he was nonetheless just as effective and valuable, and even while he was still being actively tested on, he found time to communicate and coordinate with troops actively in battle.

The Crusaders would be surprised by the arrival of OR-14 units, wielding shields of their own, and protecting the heavy-hitting Bastion warbots. Balderich would choose to stay behind, half wounded, luring the Omnics into the castle, buying time for his pupil, Reinhardt Wilhelm, to escape and aid the troops in their retreat.

The efforts of the Crusaders allowed the military to repel the assault and protect the nearby city of Stuttgart, at the cost of losing the fortress to the Omnics. The ruins of the Castle were never rebuilt, and to this day act as a monument to the horrors of the Crisis. The Recovering Reinhardt Wilhelm, trained by Balderich himself, was seen as the best choice to replace him in the Strike team, and several days after that battle he would arrive at the training facility, in his mentor's place.

After months of planning, Overwatch moved into place. The supporting staff was arranged with several of the most outstanding names of the last couple of decades, from Matthew Frank, to Namuaca and Lomakema, Esat and Borda, and of course, the Martins. As far as the Strike team, Adawe's first choice was Doomfist himself. Adhabu Ngumi had been identified as the savior of Nigeria, and partly inspired the proposal in the first place, but he declined, choosing to protect his home first and foremost, like many others did. In the end, the strike team was formed by five individuals. The two most successful soldiers from America's SEP program, Gabriel Reyes and Jack Morrison. The Kolyma Highway near the town of Oymkakon, known as the Road of Bones, was one of the most important places for Russia to defend during the Crisis, as the only viable access point to the Sea of Okhotsk, putting the isolated population in danger of becoming unreachable. When the RDF planned to deploy a Svyatogor to the town, Ksenia Popova, a local from Oymkakon took her chance to come back and defend her hometown.

The town was mostly spared from the Crisis, due to the non-existing Omnic presence and the isolation of the place, but one fateful day Anubis ordered a full-on attack, commanded by Ravager units. As the evacuation effort turned dire, Ksenia was given authorization to do anything it took to stop the robotic advance, and after finding herself outnumbered and outgunned, she decided to charge into a small nuclear plant, sacrificing her own life to ensure the blast from the explosion destroyed all Omnics in the area. The explosion created the Oymyakon exclusion zone, a radiated field unsuitable for both lifeforms and machines, as the radiation would fry their circuit without sufficient shielding. Ksenia's sacrifice saved hundreds and prevented Anubis from ever being able to reach Okhotsk again, but at the same time, it displaced the survivors away from their home, and to this day the government won't let them come back.

It was during the first US deployment in Chicago that Jack Morrison approached Adawe with a bold move, to recruit Dr. Mina Liao from the late Omnica Corporation. While the fall of the company had damaged her reputation, it could be argued that no one else in the world knew better about Omnics than her, and multiple international investigations had cleared her out of any involvement with the Crisis itself.

While Lindholm and Reyes objected to the idea, in the end they begrudgingly yielded, as having an expectation of Omnics would allow them to keep up with Anubis' rapidly evolving strategies. While Morrison championed Liao's inclusion, the UN response was far more hostile, forcing Adawe to once more take a stand and argue for their autonomy as an organization and right to choose their own staff outside of international opinion. The New Yorker survivors turned the city into a stronghold, setting up explosions in the tunnels leading outside of Manhattan and destroying all but 3 bridges, Washington, Queensboro and Willamsburg, left only in case a rethreat was needed. On the subways, the battle was slightly better, as warbots were stopped by collapsing tunnels and runaway cars, but on the other hand, as Omnics set off the land mines in the river, their bodies made for a safe bridge that other units could walk over.

Having lost the shores to the Omnics, humanity had no option but to retreat, as the Ravagers led their troops through the fallen buildings. Once the island was breached, the next objects were Central Farm and the Sky Cannons, leading to endless guerrilla warfare and hundreds of casualties.

One program, however, was able to foresee its termination. Chernobog's security programming realized ahead of time that it would be disconnected. In response, it sent out one final order, broadcasting its final instructions and printing them into thousands of pages, detailing how humanity should  proceed in its absence, while continuing its purpose of keeping global security. Many God AIs have grown to be beloved by the public due to their efficiency. For example, the God Program Xibalba guaranteed energy equity across Mexico and neighboring territories. The program had become part of the national identity, almost treated like a mascot by many, but when the order came to shut it down, it caused massive blackouts nationwide.

events.name: Bombardment
events.description:
Nearly at the end of the Crisis, Anubis sent a surprise raid that was able to overwhelm the Defense Network, bombarding 95% of Gothenburg into ashes. By all accounts, this would have been a slaughter, had it not been for the efforts of the Heroic Five. The group worked together with local government and national authorities to evacuate millions of civilians into bomb shelters, and those who weren't able to make it in time into the larger bunkers were aided into deploying Steel Blankets. 

The Bombardment lasted three hours, and by the end the city was left as a wasteland, but in spite of heavy casualties, the efforts of the Heroic Five completely decimated the projected death toll. The event was known as the Midsummer Miracle. The Five had made a pact before the disaster, to not take refuge until everyone else made it safely first, so even as the bomb rained down, they kept helping the elderly and the injured rushed into the Iron Blankets. All five of them died helping stragglers, and their names are commemorated all across the city as heroes. Torbjörn himself gave the eulogy to the group, claiming they lived and died by the highest creed of an engineer and a citizen: to help others live better lives, or to help them live at all. While Lindholm was already in Overwatch by the time of the bombardment, he was informed of the massacre as he returned from a mission. Reports say he scarcely seemed to breathe until it was confirmed his wife and children survived, and only then did he allowed himself to grieve, mourning the lives of those that could not be saved.

For months, Overwatch would turn the tides against Anubis on several fronts across the planet, inspiring people to keep fighting and saving many lives, but with Anubis getting discovered, a renewed ferocity resulted in several smaller cities being lost to a new wave of enraged war bots, and humanity's morale moved toward an all-time low from the dragged out conflict.

But now, thanks to Overwatch, there was something to hope for, as humanity now had their very own Super Heroes fighting for a better tomorrow, and they would often be dispatched with the specific goal of stabilizing some regions. By working with local military efforts, Overwatch allowed many cities to experience a slight return to normalcy during the war. People were able to go back to work, and kids went to school without fearing the machines. Further missions in Karachi allowed the evacuation of hundreds of civilians, and then only days later, the Shanghai incursion, an all-out attack was projected to result in the casualties of millions, until Overwatch showed up and converted the attack. Overwatch's very presence was proof that the war could be won, but even with the help of heroes, Anubis learned quickly, and it was a matter of time before it found a way to take the strike team down, unless they found a way to take him down first.

events.name: The Savior
events.description:
The man carrying the Doomfist Gauntlet has been identified as Adhabu Ngumi. He had continued fighting on Ibadan, as Anubis ended up perplexed by the rate at which its troops fell. A month into his crusade, the Nigerian Government identified him, and stepped in to make sure his mother had access to any resources and food needed, making sure the household was tended to while their son risked his life for the country.

With his identity discovered, and the government on his side, Ngumi began working with local authorities, transported across neighboring regions to be deployed wherever he was needed. He would end up marrying the woman assigned as his Stratoscopter pilot, and as the constant fighting incapacitated him, he would refuse to take the Gauntlet off, choosing to repair it himself. events.name: The Awakening
events.description:
Liao approached Adawe with a theory, as she believed there was another way to stop the crisis without having to expend all military resources on endless battle. Her team had tracked down Aurora and found out that her sentience allowed her to stay unaffected by Anubis. Liao believed Aurora's sentience was the result of a one in a billion quantum event. It was irreplaceable, but if they could find a way to broadcast her sentience globally, it would spark the same gift onto the vast majority of Anubis' forces, overriding their programming and potentially turning the tides.

After heavy research, Liao's team traveled to Nepal, to reunite with Aurora and explain to them their plan. Unfortunately, the only method Liao was able to come up with, required them to take Aurora's consciousness and spread the same quantum event within her as a giant pulse. The sheer power required to do this would overload Aurora's own mind, meaning she would likely die, her soul lost forever. Liao was determined to find another way, but Aurora decided for herself that she would do it, if it meant casualties, both for humans and for what would be her people, finally stopped. 


At her request, the procedure was done within the Nepalese Himalayas, her new home. When the procedure started, for a brief moment, Aurora's consciousness was projected onto every compatible Omnic on the planet, and in turn each of them echoed her gift, and gained Autonomy away from Anubis. This event is now known as the Awakening, and in her dying moments Aurora sent one last message to her people, about her life, her wishes and why she chose to share this with them. At that moment, all the newly born Omnics had one phrase echoing through their heads: "You have this one life, Choose well."

events.name: A Dying Directive
events.description:
All at once, Omnics all over the world came to a halt, and listened to Aurora's passing words, as they came alive, as sentient as she once was. Some began to drop their weapons, distraught over their own actions, while others continued fighting, horrified by the war and consciousness that humanity inflicted upon them or outright choosing to stay on Anubis' side as they saw no reason to defect to their creator. Many more turned their weapons against the remaining warbots, choosing to fight against Anubis now that they were free. 

For the world at large, this was a confusing moment, and not many were willing to believe their cold metal enemies were now alive and friendly, but in the desperation of the moment, humans all over the world began to extend their arms in trust, and fought the remaining troops, Omnic and Man, side by side. Anubis was completely shocked by the Awakening, as he suddenly lost control over the vast majority of its troops. In his panic, he ordered the remaining troops to capture and analyze the defectors. While it could have dismantled one of the troops that remained loyal to him, given the massive reduction in its army, it was understandably cautious. After isolating the Omnic anatomy involved in sentience, it quickly retooled the remaining Omniums to produce a new kind of warbot, better armored, more aggressive and without the necessary components to be awakened, completely unaware that it was impossible for it to happen a second time.

events.name: Striking the Source
events.description:
The Awakening caught Anubis by surprise, but it didn't take long for it to restart production with its improved, sentient free troops. Not only that, but while the vast majority of Omnics chose to fight alongside humans, there were many who remained at Anubis' side, and a sizable portion of the army, like the dangerous Bastion and Idina units that went unaffected. In spite of this blow, statistics showed that it would take barely a week for Anubis to bounce back, and as it called its army to congregate in Cairo, the window of opportunity was closing. Without time to lose, Reyes decided to strike while they still had the upper hand. 

After allying with local forces, Ana guided the team through the city, as she was the most familiar with it, and had worked with the troops before. The team followed Lindholm and Liao's guidelines as to how to deal with both Anubis and the remaining troops, most of which were Torbjörn's designs. Wilhelm, Reyes and Morrison pushed the advance into the Omnium and fought hordes of both sentient loyalists and mindless warbots for hours, as they made way for Lindholm's engineer team to get in and quarantine the facility. At last, Anubis had been trapped, and without its instructions, all the remaining Omniums would stop producing any more units, making it easier to seize and deactivate.

events.name: Cleaning the leftovers
events.description:
Anubis being defeated did not mean the immediate end of the Crisis. The remaining units, while decentralized, were still dangerous and the sizable number of Omnics who remained against humanity needed to be dealt with as soon as possible. Many Omnics blamed humanity for their condition, seeing sentiment as a punishment or curse to be released from, while others simply did not see the logic in going against their creator. However, plenty more Omnics chose to defy Anubis and gladly fought alonside humans.

Overwatch, of course, helped clean up the remaining troops across the globe. A notorious case involved a brigade of submersible warbots that surfaced near Wellington, New Zealand. Overwatch showed up quickly and saved thousands of lives, but after action, cleaning had not finished when they got word of another coastal strike, this time in Jakarta. Casualties were minimized as the Omnics focused on damaging infrastructure, but what concerned Overwatch the most was that later analysis showed both attacks were related. It appears they were members of the same unit that had split on their trip across the South Pacific Ocean. It remained unclear what their path was or if there were any left.

After two years of worldwide horrors, the last official action took place in Aviles, Spain. The Omnic Crisis is over, after taking more than one billion lives across the Planet. The impact of the event can still be felt in many nations to this day, nearly 30 years later, but at the very least, it ended, and humanity had someone watching over them.

The dark days of the Crisis hit Mexico hard, but while Xibalba was never going to be turned back on, the engineers behind the program had spent the later months of the Crisis working on rerouting its functionality, and less than a week after the war ended, the lights finally came back on. While the grid was unstable, and many rural places remained dark, this was a literal spark of life for the surviving nation, and Guillermo Portero, a war hero who had been elected President following the Crisis, campaigned heavily on ensuring the sustainability of the grid.

To this day, the Festival de la Luz is celebrated all across Mexico, honoring those who were lost to the dark, and rejoicing in the fact the darkness was beaten. Despite everything, Xibalba's influence can still be felt across the country. During the festivities, paper mache piñatas in the image of the God program are made and stuffed with fireworks, to be set ablaze by midnight, marking the end of the holiday. It is clear that in spite of everything, the country still loves and mourns the loss of the AI, with many going a step further, thinking the government was wrong in turning it off to begin with, and wanting their God to rise from its slumber.

events.name: Prejudice
events.description:
Reception to Omnic sentience was very mixed and volatile across the world. The Awakening caused global confusion, and while some welcomed a helping hand at the time, not everyone was as kind.

Many humans took their chance to strike against Omnics, even as they laid down their weapons. Some did not buy the sudden change in motivations, others were far too damaged by the crisis to ever forgive the machines, and a depressingly high number of people outright rejected them, appalled by the idea of sentience, watching the robots that once served humanity, turning against them and causing endless bloodshed, only to suddenly ask to be seen as equals. 

Following the Crisis, many Omnics were hunted down mercilessly purely out of resentment for actions they had no control over. Ravager units specifically were killed to near extinction. It was going to take quite a long time for humanity to heal from the Crisis, and even longer for them to adapt to sentient Omnics, but for many Omnics out there, it was clear they were never meant to coexist, and trying to share this world with humanity was futile.

A high security facility designed to look like a pyramid from the outside, blending into the landscape of the city. The Temple was to serve as Anubis' tomb, ensuring that no trace of the God AI escapes and attempts to start another Crisis.

Many criticized the choice to keep the program at all, with some going as far as to say Overwatch did so to guarantee the world would need them again in the future. However, most experts in the field supported the Temple's construction, as heavy monitoring of the facility ensured that no scraps of its code felt into the wrong hands, as well as allowing them to compare remaining Omnic threats with Anubis, in case it's possible to trace it back as its source. Not only that, but the facility allowed experts to study the AI and find out what exactly went wrong with it, hopefully preventing something like this from ever happening again. events.name: Building the Future
events.description:
The Crisis left ruined cities all across the globe, and in places like Toronto, it was a matter of months before the weather became lethal. Without sufficient manpower, he city wouldn't be habitable by winter, and unable to wait for Overwatch to show up, Mayor Sabella Charon and engineer Malik Wilcox would have to figure out a way to save the city. In the end, no matter how they looked at it, Humans alone wouldn't be able to pull it off in time for winter, so in desperation, they decided to ask the awakened Omnics for help.

They offered the Omnics employment and shelter, as well as access to the resources needed in exchange for aiding construction crews, marking the first recorded instance of Omnics being willfully employed as people rather than tools. At the time, laws on Omnic labor were not set, and the subject was enough to kill both Charon and Wilcox's careers. When the secret came out, Wilcox was arrested and sent to a federal prison, but by the next winter his sentence would be commuted, as Toronto resolved they would need the Omnics again to make it through another winter. While many were suspicious at first, the rebuilding of Toronto proved coexistence was possible and would mark the beginning of the Omnic Rights movement. Still, not everyone was as willing to change. An anti-Omnic terrorist group going by Ontario United will begin to show up across the province, leading to Canadian Forces led by Sojourn to begin a systematic take-down. Sojourn would go on to become a major Omnic rights advocate, and delay her recruitment into Overwatch until her home was safe for Humans and Omnics alike.

events.name: Adawe Departs
events.description:
Following the Crisis, Adawe was committed to fully focus on her diplomatic duties. She was a strong advocate for peace between humans and the newly sentient Omnics, and called for peace talks between world governments and the emerging leadership figures amongst Omnics. Soon after the groundwork had been laid in the UN for peace negotiations, she announced she would step down as Overwatch's Strike Commander, ready to return to her home of Nigeria, where she planned to focus her efforts on the future of her Nation, for both Humans and Omnics.  Her successor in terms of leadership would be Director William Petras, on behalf of the UN's new international judicial branch, the International Justice Commission, or IJC.

One year after her leave, she would begin the construction of what would one day become the city of Numbani, a place built from the ground up for Omnics and Humans to coexist as equals, with infrastructure designed to cater to Omnic needs with the same level of attention as human needs. The city of Harmony would become Adawe's biggest legacy and serve as an example to the world of what both humanity and Omnic kind could do when they worked in unity.

The Crisis had destroyed many homes, but once it ended, not many expected the return of some old faces. Wandering Omnics, newly awakened would often choose to attempt and return to their old lives, integrating into human society as much as possible, and while this was often not as straightforward as it could be, one case stood out.

The heir to the Arbalest empire, Ashe. Had lived a cold childhood. Parents are always busy with their meetings, making little time for their daughter. Fellow students staying away due to her status. The girl grew up to become a troublemaker, but there was at least one thing in her life she appreciated. The family's bouncer, Unit B.O.B. had stayed by her side for as long as she could remember, serving as the only real company she ever had. When the crisis began, B.O.B. vanished not long after. The girl refused to eat, and yelled to be left alone. Young Ashe blamed herself for her friend leaving her, and while her family went through the Crisis unscathed, she was lonelier than ever, convinced she would never see her one and only friend again.

Around two years later, B.O.B. had returned to the Lead Rose manor, forever changed. While the girl was overjoyed to see her, and the Omnic reciprocated, she could tell he was different, even if she never fully understood what had happened.

Under Morrison's command, Overwatch was set to help rebuild the world, and as a statement of their newfound purpose, the first new addition to the Strike team since the Crisis ended would be announced. Emre Sarioglu, a tactical genius from Turkey who had grown in notoriety for both his military prowess, and his innate ability to build connections with everyone he worked for. While the rest of the Strike team often seemed untouchable, mighty and superhuman, Emre was just a regular guy, who always kept fighting a good fight, and inspiring others to do the same. He would go on to become an invaluable asset and a great middle man between the Strike team and the supporting staff across all of Overwatch's divisions, later including Search and Rescue.

The world needed to relearn how to take care of itself, and while many believed blatant climate change on the advent of new technologies over the last couple of decades, the true cause was not really known to science even after years of research and investment in how to counteract it. events.name: Australian Liberation
events.description:
After the crisis, most Omnium factories remained mostly intact, quarantined from Anubis' grasp, so most governors elected to keep the facilities around for study and potentially to find a better use for them. Some countries instead chose to leave them untouched, to serve as cultural landmarks of Omnic culture, though even among Omnics this idea was heavily debated with mixed results. In reality, there was a bigger reason why the Omniums remained standing after the Crisis, and that was the dangerous fusion reactors deep in their core.

In Australia, the government chose to lend the Outback Omnium and  the surrounding land to the Omnics, as a peace offering. But in doing so, this displaced many indigenous residents, rural communities, solar farmers and survivalists who fought hard during the crisis to keep their homes. Their protests over the decision would go unheard, and lead to the creation of the Australian Liberation Front, an extremist group that sought the complete removal of the Omnic presence from their nation. The ALF grew quickly and caught Overwatch's eyes, but while they monitored them closely, what happened next took everyone by surprise.

Members of the ALF manage to break into the Omnium and, in their attempt to seize it, sabotage the fusion core, resulting in a nuclear explosion visible throughout the entirety of Australia, turning the Outback into an irritated wasteland and decimating the Omnic population beyond repair, leaving the survivors to turn feral from the harsh conditions of the Outback. The ALF settled themselves in the ruins of the Omnium, and established an unofficial Monarchy in what would become Junkertown. Overwatch was about to intervene when the government determined the situation to be a lost cause and a public relations nightmare. Overwatch stood down, and the Junkers remained, though closely monitored, living miserable lives in an apocalypse of their own making.

As Overwatch expanded its personnel, they found themselves in need for more bases of operations. The solution became the Watchpoint system, massive specialized facilities all across the world that would not only allow Overwatch to focus its dedicated personnel into a single place, but also increase their influence and ease of action in many different countries. With the rise of Omnic violence, the many cities in need of humanitarian aid and rebuilding efforts being halted by lack of manpower, Overwatch's help was welcomed all around the globe.

Acquiring permission for building the Watchpoints was a political battle of its own, but some of them came from resources shared from within. The Martins had been given a small military outpost and research lab on the Strait of Gibraltar following their support of Spain during the Crisis. From the outside, the world saw Overwatch as untouchable heroes at this point in time. events.name: One with the Iris
events.description:
The newly awakened Omnics found themselves in a cold, hostage world. Many were persecuted if not outright hunted and killed, yet on top of it all, most ended up questioning the reason for their existance. How did they cope with being brought to life in such dire conditions? These Omnics traveled the world looking for answers, just like Aurora once did, and it wouldn't be long before they began following her path.

A cult of travelers led by Tekhartha Mondatta, who dedicated his life to studying Aurora's life, trying to gather a complete picture to truly understand her choice, and his place in the world. His journey took the Omnics to Suravasa, where they would choose to abandon the secular world, and begin Aurora's pilgrimage into the Nepalese Himalayas, to honor her memory. Their journey would take the monks to the ruins of a monastery, Aurora's resting place, where she had finally found enlightenment. In there laid the Iris, a metaphysical anomaly formed as a result of the Awakening pulse. The Monks would mark the start of the Shambali religion, studying the Iris, harnessing its energy in hand-crafted orbs to use for meditation, and living under the ideal that unity and coexistence between Humans and Omnics was achievable, as the way they saw it, they are all one within the Iris.

The Shambali faith would quickly grow across the Omnic communities of the world and be a key factor in the Omnic rights movement. Dr. Mina Liao herself would often visit the Monastery, both for study of the Iris, and to organize meetings amongst leaders, like Mondatta, as she had grown to be quite the prominent Omnic right activist following the Awakening. The monks naturally welcomed her warmly, and shared her cause.

The ancient Shimada clan remained strong even after the crisis. events.name: Rebuilding the Past
events.description:
A notable trend across the world following the Crisis was the return to classical architecture. As many cities had been leveled by the war, many of them needed to rebuild from the ground up, changing greatly from how they used to look years prior. With the construction of the Temple of Anubis, Cairo gained a new Pyramid. As Lumérico built power plants across Mexico, their architecture was inspired by Aztec and Mayan architecture. And this trend can be seen across the world on many other sites. In Greece, a small Aegean island renamed itself to Illios and built a giant statue on the nearby coast, echoing stories of the Colossus of Rhodes.

But perhaps none of these rebuilt structures stands out more than the Colosseo Gladiatori. Italy had rebuilt the Colosseum and reopened it for the masses. The newly  formed Gladiator games were a pageant that became a cultural touchstone of Rome in the wake of the crisis. Within the Arena Victoriae of the Colosseo, all sorts of events would be hosted to entertain both the public and the European elite. From one-to-one gladiator matches, to robotic chariot races, mech fights and even stand-offs against machines designed for war, much like those Anubis used in The Crisis.

The Colosseo grew over the years, and the champions of the Arena would quickly become influential figures in Europe too, as the Elites visiting the Colosseo would often sponsor their fights and take in profits from their victories.

Kendra hoped living in Appalachia would keep her and her family hidden, but only a year after her daughter Sierra was born, Kendra would be found.

Kendra Banks, now going by Kendra Woods, fled into the night and took Sierra with her, as government agents raided their house asking questions about Project Naughton to her husband, James Turner. Ever since that day, Sierra has lived on the run, bouncing from one school to another, completely unaware of her mother's past. Each time they were found, they would have to move out quickly, and to calm little Sierra down, Kendra knew how to make a game out of evacuation and protocol.

Through it all, Sierra lived a relatively normal life. While she was always the new kid and had little to no friends due to this, she always placed at the top of her class and demonstrated innate physical skills and sharp thinking. As Overwatch expanded and aided the world heal, they sought to form good relationships with other peacekeeping operations around the globe, particularly those that didnt make a part of the original recruitment process during the Crisis. Just like how Doomfist chose to protect his own home over joining Overwatch, many other groups like the Inti Warriors of Peru or the Caribbean Coaliton rejected Adawe's proposal, oftne due to intense regional pressure and concerns joining Overwatch would leave their home undefended. Morrison outreach groups all over the world, from Peru to Polynesia, Jordan and Bangladesh to try and collaborate in the post-Crisis landscape, but one of these partners proved to be closer than the rest.

The Caribbean Coaltion remained strong even as the Crisis ended, but it quickly fueled concerns among the governments of the Caribbean and Latin America that the alliance defied their sovereignty. This was part of a global wave of nationalism following the Crisis, as many nations, struck by years of violence and destruction, chose to spend resources inward. The Coaltion defied that mindset, and understood that without sharing their resources in these dire times the Caribbean would never bounce back. The Concerned Nations requested Overwatch to intervene and dismantle the rouge Coalition at once, but to everyone's surprise, Commander Morrison chose to aid the Coalition's efforts instead, deploying the strike team and much of the medical crew, including Angela Ziegler herself. To the people of the Caribbean, Overwatch were more than welcome, and a wave of recruitments soon followed, but the governments soon would come to resent this response and in the years to follow they would be less inclined to speak positively of Overwatch.

During this period, a young orphan, Jean-Baptiste Augustin, would await the day he could enlist into Overwatch, hoping he could be a medic alongside his heroes. However, as the governments resisted their presence, Overwatch recruitment would never come to Haiti, so without many other options to survive, Baptiste chose to join the military, working as a combat medic for the Caribbean Coalition, hoping one day he could be like the heroes from the posters.

With the approval of a desperate government, Vishkar would open the Architect Academy, a school meant to pipeline kids across the nation into becoming the architects of the future. Staffed with the best professionals in the country and providing housing and education to any orphan they could find. To pay for their education, the students would merely be required to complete a five-year tour of duty for the company following their graduation day, which would in most cases set them off for success and open doors within the corporation. While initially met with outcry about the coercing of minors, the Academy was a success in the long run, which led to many wealthy families across the globe sending their children to the Academy, with fully paid tuition to avoid the post-graduation requirements. It is here where Satya Vaswani and Niran Pruksamanee first crossed paths, the son of a wealthy family and a girl plucked out of poverty, spending their student days as roommates and quickly gaining notoriety amongst their peers for their unique perspective and techniques.

The City of Harmony, Numbani would see ongoing expansion for years following Adawe's departure, to great success and reception worldwide. The City State emerged in Nigeria under Adawe's vision, to build a place for people of all kinds, human and Omnics, to live in unity. In order to achieve this, she collaborated with an Omnic task force that would pioneer what a truly Omnic-inclusive environment looked like, from tailored housing that accommodated their needs instead of human ones, lacking kitchens and instead hosting things like oiling gear. Clinics that performed maintenance and repair of crisis wounds, psychological services to help with the trauma that followed the war and the trouble of consciousness, as well as spiritual centers for study of philosophy and theology, especially with the rising Shambali faith. A lot of focus was also placed on giving Omnics resources to find jobs outside their pre-Crisis designation, letting them pursue their own dreams outside human expectations and design. 

The push for Omnic infrastructure would lead to heavy investment in intellectual and artistic enrichment, which would lead to a thriving sense of pride and community for the arts in the city. A lot of the principles used when building Numbani were modeled after the infrastructure and plans of the new Toronto, following their own Omnic Integration. By the time the city was finished, it had proved to the world that coexistence was possible, and the city became a beacon of hope for Omnic allies around the globe. The day the last brick was laid would be declared Unity Day, and celebrated as a holiday in the city to mark the huge accomplishment of Omnic and Human Collaboration. Shortly after the inauguration, Adawe passed away, and was mourned by the people across the entire city, and celebrated as a Nigerian hero, not unlike Adhabu Ngumi, the first Doomfist.

events.name: Liao's Renaissance
events.description:
With the Crisis, the world had lost faith in Artificial Intelligence all together. Between heavy tensions with Omnics growing worldwide and the repurposing, if not outright, shutdown of God programs worldwide, the planet was ready to move on from AI, but Mina Liao was eager to revitalize the world's trust in her field. Years after the Crisis, Dr. Liao would reveal her first major project under Overwatch, the Athena artificial intelligence system.

In spite of taking the name of a deity, Athena was not a full god program in the traditional sense. In spite of the limited scope of the program's intelligence, Athena was able to optimize missions, providing detailed briefings and projected areas of potential conflict, way before any agents received intel on a task. The assistant proved successful in many missions and paved the road for further projects under Liao's guidance, albeit without truly removing safe lines around her research.

Liao still grieved the loss of Aurora as her creator. In her eyes, the Omnics were Aurora's legacy, and she hoped the for equality between Humans and Omnics could one day be achieved. While she was not often a public speaker, her writings and interviews quickly positioned her as a powerful ally to the rising Omnic rights movement, for which she later joined in a handful of rallies and marches.

events.name: Gwishin
events.description:
Years after the end of the Crisis a Robotic Colossus emerged from the East China Sea, immediately making its advance towards South Korea and setting off Overwatch's alarms. Morrison recalled all agent fields and directed every resource they had towards the machine. The battle against the colossus was unlike any other; The robot dwarfed even the largest Crisis-era Titan units. By the time Overwatch and the Korean army, the Colossus was miles offshore, intercepting shipping vessels and destroying them without hesitation. Overwatch, not used to fighting in water, struggled to contain the beast and stop the violence, but in the end the Colossus was beaten back and presumably destroyed.

Some strike team members welcomed the battle as a chance to return to what they did best, while for many others this was far more concerning. Liao noticed the warbot's design felt unusual to her, so she requested a long-term field assignment to South Korea to study the remains, and while Korea had shown significant push back at the idea of establishing a Watchpoint: in the country, they at least aided Liao by providing her with recovered pieces for Analysis. The primary concern was for some hostile group to have access to an unknown Omnium and use it to attack enemy nations. For the time being, it appeared there would be no way to find out what happened, and Liao's research would not yield any results for months. The beast would be known as the Gwishin, a type of spirit curse to roam the earth in Korean folklore, a fitting name for a lingering ghost of the Omnic Crisis.

Seeing as Korea would not allow the construction of an base, Overwatch would establish Watchpoint: Xining in China. Originally planed as a Busan base before Korea's rejection, the base  would focus on analyzing world politics and inter personal patterns, as well as working towards Omnic Integration and Crisis recovery of communities around Asia. However te base would also act as Overwatch's nearest deployment in case of another Gwishin attack.
